title: Last Decoration of Departure
author: Bijayalaxmi Rath
text:
Your transparent love
A soft fierce drench to
my sheer existence.
Love to float being
Mellow and mature.
Colourful drop-down.
Joy of blowing down with
grace is my chosen ego.
I respect my enthusiastic
acceptance, sublime submission
as well as soulful strategy of
merging to own.
Self validation with soul`s approval.
Rise and fall is the calm susurrus
of definite "To Be".
"Not to Be", is the fallacy where
life ignores self identity and
true credentiality.
When numerous crimson dreams
soaked in misty waft of Autumn
randomly connect and collide
illuminates life`s twilight.
Comfortable becomes own skin.
Solitude star gazing turns a
privileged hobby.
Enhanced loneliness starts
passionate gap filling between
Autumnal Earth and Autumnal Life
Last decoration of Departure.
